newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria, Croatia vow to boost communication ties.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria, Croatia vow to boost communication ties.

text.p: The head of Bulgaria's Posts and Communications Committee, Lyubomir Kolarov, and Croatia's Minister of Transport Zeljko Luzavec agreed to restore and develop bilateral ties at talks on Thursday.

"In a short term experts from the two communication administrations and the national operators will discuss the sectors and the ways for widening the cooperation between the two countries," said a committee statement.
Luzavec is in Sofia for a conference of transport ministers from the Central European Initiative and the Black Sea Economic Cooperation.
"The two institutions agreed to put into operation 30 digital telephone lines between Sofia and Zagreb," the statement said.

Kolarov and Luzavec also discussed supplies of Bulgarian telecommunication equipment, television retranslators and phone card machines to Croatia, and Bulgarian imports of Croatian digital exchanges, the statement said.
